top_signals.title: AI Policy Risks Loom Over Stock, Bond Traders Ahead of Midterms
top_signals.summary: Wall Street expects Democrats to win at least one of the houses of Congress in the US midterm elections on Tuesday, setting the stage for a potentially volatile ride in the stock and bond markets with artificial intelligence oversight, defense spending and crypto legislation on the table.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
